description: What ELSE happened around a moment in time. Given an instant — the spike log_trends returned, or the time of an alert — find the patterns that cluster there and do not appear the same way in the rest of the log. Correlation is NOT causation, and what settles it is order: what started BEFORE comes first and is a candidate explanation; what came after is usually a consequence. Background noise is filtered out even when a narrow window lands on one of its bursts.

format.description: Force the format instead of detecting it

from.description: Which end to read if the file is over 32 MB

path.description: Path to the log file. Use this for big logs: they do not fit in a tool call.

radiusSeconds.description: How far to look on each side

text.description: The log as text. Alternative to `path`.
